description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeLicenseModel class, which provides a serializable model representing an employee's license in the OrangeHRM system. It encapsulates license details such as license number, issue date, expiry date, and license metadata, and maps them for API responses.

classes.name: EmployeeLicenseModel
classes.description: A model class representing an employee's license details for API serialization within OrangeHRM.
